integrity: The proof separates published structural inputs from the finite computation. Classical uniqueness of the perfect K8 one-factorization is treated as prior, not rediscovered. The bundled verifier independently exhausts the K8 factorization and deletion claims.
limitations: The classification permits permutation of the seven diversity atoms and the qualitative/perfect bridge is proved only for the K8 case. The main originality risk is uncatalogued folklore because the deduction is short once the 2023 qualitative-representation theorem is combined with the classical one-factorization census. The finite verifier does not re-prove the published unique-extension theorem.
title: Three atom-permuting qualitative representation classes for \(\mathfrak E_8^{\{3\}}\)
